description: Post-1.0 Phase 22 — telemetry-informed tutorial friction fixes. Copy + presentation timing/nudges only; advanceOn triggers, step ids, and schema 20 stay frozen. Funnel uses Phase 25 tutorial_step_completed stepIndex.

constraints.note: Phase 23 owns balance/contentVersion 1.0.1; this phase only retunes teaching copy and HUD nudge timing.

funnel.source: Phase 25 consent-gated tutorial_step_completed; closed-test + first-session drop hypotheses

dropHypotheses.reason: Cast/reel timing window unclear; players mash Reel early or never hold Cast
Teal In pad vs Out pad confusion; bag full without walking onto pad
Upgrades panel undiscovered; players keep fishing without spending
Jobs panel + deliver destination opaque after first sale
Hire gated behind Make 10 sales; copy did not name the unlock

copyPatches.text: Walk to the pier tip — stand where the boards meet the water
Catch 3 fish: hold Cast, then tap Reel while the meter is green
Carry fish onto the teal In pad on the cutter's left
Pick up portions from the Out pad on the cutter's right
Stock the counter pad so waiting customers can buy
Stay at the counter — sales ring up when the pad has stock
Open Upgrades and buy a bigger bag with your sale coins
Open Jobs, accept a harbor contract, then deliver the listed goods
After Make 10 sales unlocks hiring, open Staff and hire your first hand
When the grill unlocks, deliver fish to the charcoal In pad
Stand on an expansion marker and confirm spend to place a new pad

nudges.nudge: Tip: hold Cast to charge, release timing into the green Reel window
Tip: walk onto the left teal pad — dropping nearby is not enough
Tip: tap Upgrades (or press U) — Bag capacity is the first buy
Tip: Jobs lists contracts; accept one, then carry the goods to the drop
Tip: keep selling until Make 10 sales, then Staff unlocks Hire
